comparisonMethod.commands: Exact JSON structure equality for action_ref and data, also cross-checked against native campaign action records. No action substitution or data normalization.

excludedSourceSuffix.reason: The current campaign stops at its requested three-level target; the old fixture continues into later-level exploration. Only the common three-level prefix is compared.

limitedDomainProjection.reason: The historical fixture exposes a narrower public input domain than the fresh native campaign. The added ACTION7 is never issued in either compared trajectory.
limitedDomainProjection.rule: For the projected comparison only, retain native references also declared in the original fixture packet, preserving order. Keep both raw domains and the strict mismatch at every checkpoint.

comparisonMethod.objectKeyOrder: JSON object member ordering is semantically ignored; array ordering is retained. Stored structural hashes use sorted keys and compact JSON.
comparisonMethod.pixelAndAnimationPolicy: All pixel values, image dimensions, animation frame counts and frame ordering must match exactly. No raster, timing-frame or score normalization.

qualification.inputScope: Previously recorded public commands, canonical frames, complete public animation packets, official metadata, source agent provenance and campaign receipts.
qualification.scopeLimit: Preservation of the original recall component mechanism on this 30-action public trajectory. The unchanged original full caller historically selected an unlearned invitation at action 7 and failed. The v40 caller uses an explicitly declared native priority extension.

summary.interpretation: The 30 choices and every displayed return preserve the original isolated recall trajectory. Their selection by the complete caller is a native coordinator improvement, not a claim that the unchanged original caller followed this trajectory.
